verdict.rationale: The only sign of an in-product AI assistant is a pricing-page line item, "Composer & Review Agent," with no description of what users can delegate to it. The other agent-related evidence (MCP server, CLI, Agent Quickstart) is about equipping external agents, so it does not count as a built-in assistant. Missing for 10: documentation of what Composer/Review Agent does inside the product, which tasks users can delegate to it and how, and any hands-on or independent corroboration.
